dashboard.label: SSL / TLS Security Audit
dashboard.description: Audit weak ciphers, deprecated TLS protocols, and certificate trust chain anomalies.

search.query: `ssl_cert_index` sourcetype="cert:ssl:json" | eval dest=coalesce(dest, target_host), dest_port=coalesce(dest_port, port) | stats latest(ssl_version) as ssl_version, latest(ssl_cipher) as ssl_cipher, latest(ssl_issuer) as ssl_issuer, latest(issuer_cn) as issuer_cn, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | search ssl_version IN ("TLSv1", "TLSv1.1", "SSLv2", "SSLv3") OR ssl_cipher="*RC4*" OR ssl_cipher="*3DES*" OR ssl_cipher="*NULL*" | eval Target=dest . ":" . dest_port, Issuer=coalesce(ssl_issuer, issuer_cn), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") | table Target, sni, ssl_version, ssl_cipher, Issuer, last_seen | rename Target as "Endpoint", sni as "SNI", ssl_version as "Protocol", ssl_cipher as "Negotiated Cipher", last_seen as "Audit Timestamp"

`ssl_cert_index` sourcetype="cert:ssl:json" has_missing_intermediate=true | eval dest=coalesce(dest, target_host), dest_port=coalesce(dest_port, port) | stats latest(issuer_cn) as missing_intermediate_issuer, latest(subject_cn) as subject_cn, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC"), Endpoint=dest . ":" . dest_port | table Endpoint, sni, subject_cn, missing_intermediate_issuer, last_seen | rename Endpoint as "Endpoint", sni as "SNI", subject_cn as "Leaf Subject", missing_intermediate_issuer as "Missing Issuer CA", last_seen as "Last Detected"

table.title: Trust Chain Expiration Audit (Intermediate & Root CAs)

search.query: `ssl_cert_index` sourcetype="cert:ssl:json" | eval dest=coalesce(dest, target_host) | spath input=certificate_chain path="{}" output=chain_element | mvexpand chain_element | spath input=chain_element | search is_self_signed=false days_remaining <= 90 | stats min(days_remaining) as days_remaining, latest(valid_to) as valid_to by subject_cn, issuer_cn, dest | eval days_remaining=round(days_remaining, 1) | sort days_remaining | rename dest as "Host", subject_cn as "CA Subject", issuer_cn as "Parent Issuer", days_remaining as "Days Remaining", valid_to as "Valid Until"
